verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Stripe CLI is documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. Stripe Tax is exposed through Stripe's APIs, so the vendor's own CLI plausibly reaches it, but nothing in the pack shows CLI commands for tax calculations, transactions or registrations, or any AI-native workflow framing. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Stripe Tax resources, documentation of tax-specific CLI usage or agent-oriented workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
